FN-XDDRIZE-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 206
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs and Public Safety Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/05/2025
Senate Bill 206 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Office of the Attorney
General, or offices of district attorneys, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the costs to
enforce violations of the Deceptive Trade Practices Act, as it relates to assisting or advising an
individual with preparation of a claim for veterans benefits. However, any increased obligations
could be offset by any civil penalties collected by the Office of the Attorney General, or offices
of district attorneys for violations of the Deceptive Trade Practices Act pursuant to the
provisions of this bill.
